component.name: opengram
component.summary: Free and minimalistic Telegram client for desktop

description.p: opengram is a free, minimalistic desktop client for Telegram, based on Telegram Desktop with a cleaner interface and fewer distractions.
It uses the official Telegram servers and protocol, requires no opengram account, and keeps your data out of third-party services.

opengram is an independent fork. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Telegram FZ-LLC, and it does not provide server-side Telegram Premium features, invisible mode, or end-to-end encryption for ordinary cloud chats.
